item.title: Ask HN: If you write release notes, what stops you from being specific?
item.summary: Slack's release notes (https://slack.com/release-notes) are mostly "Bug fixes and performance improvements." or something trying too hard to be funny. If you write release notes for software with a lot of users: what makes you go generic? I assume there's a reason past laziness and I'd rather hear it from someone who's made the call.
